Bright hello service team,
Handler training, later this week: a short note from our desk

Please take this as a reminder to keep our animal handoff notes clear, calm, and consistent when a traveler arrives with a pet. Our crew support depends on steady communication, especially when a carrier is delayed, a crate tag is unclear, or a family looks worried at the counter. We can make those moments easier by checking details carefully and speaking in a reassuring tone.

For any report tied to a travel disruption, please log the facts exactly as shared and avoid adding guesses. <<FACT F120>> If a traveler also raises a missed connection concern, record the note in the same careful way. <<FACT F110>> When we keep the record clean, the next team can step in smoothly and the traveler feels heard.

If you are unsure about a handoff, a rebooked segment, or a pet care note, bring it to the desk right away so we can guide the next step. Thank you for staying steady, respectful, and helpful with every case that reaches the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Your careful work supports both our travelers and the animals in our care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
